title: Assessment Engagement Fee Credit on a Follow-On Statement of Work — Professional Services Projects
content:
In Professional Services Projects, when a client signs an implementation statement of work after an Assessment Engagement of its own was accepted, the assessment credit share of the assessment's contract value is credited against the follow-on's deposit invoice, rounded half up to the cent and never more than that deposit.

## Credit period

The follow-on must be signed within the assessment credit period in calendar days after the assessment was accepted. The period is counted in calendar days from the assessment's completion date, that date being day 0.

- Clock start: the completion date recorded on the accepted assessment engagement.
- Comparison: the follow-on's signature must be no later than the last day of the period; the last day is within it.
- Evidence: the system record of the assessment engagement and its completion date.

## Once only

An assessment is credited at most once, to the first qualifying follow-on signed; a follow-on that is itself an Assessment Engagement earns no credit. Whether an assessment has already been credited is read from the client's project billing, where each credit names the assessment it came from.

## Decision table

| Follow-on is an implementation statement of work of the same client? | Signed within the period? | Assessment already credited? | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | No | the credit share of the assessment's contract value, never more than the follow-on's deposit |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | none |
| No (the follow-on is itself an Assessment Engagement) | any | any | none |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- An accepted assessment's contract value is 5000.00 and its credit share 100 percent: the credit is 5000.00. If the follow-on's deposit is 3000.00, the credit is 3000.00, because it is never more than that deposit.
- With a 90-day period, a follow-on signed on day 90 after the assessment's completion date is within the period; one signed on day 91 is not.
